entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' for product help or 'Sales' to place an order.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David... *sigh*... I hope you can help me. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse monitor. I just... I don't think it's for me.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, can I get your name and order number?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti, order number is VF77812.

Thank you, Maria. I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. So, to make sure I'm on the right track, is there a technical fault with the device, or is it more of a personal preference?

It's just a preference. It works fine, but it's not what I expected. And honestly, I feel terrible about this, but I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years. I tried to do this over a week ago, right after I got it.
Oh? What happened when you tried to process the return?

Well, I went online, but there must have been a website error or something. The whole return portal seemed to be experiencing issues. It just kept saying 'system down for maintenance' and I couldn't print the label. I even took a screenshot of the error message because I was so worried.
I see. I do have a note here about some intermittent system issues we had around Christmas Eve. Let me just pull up your account and our policy to see what we can do.
Okay... I just... with the holidays, things are tight and I really needed this money back. I wouldn't even be calling if I didn't have to.

I completely understand, Maria. One moment... Okay, I see the delivery was 19 days ago. Let me just confirm our return policy here... Yep, I see it right here. All our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, 90 days? Really?
Yes, absolutely. Since you're well within that 90-day window, I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you right now. No problem at all.
Oh my goodness, David, thank you so much! That's such a relief. I was so worried I had missed my chance because of that website error.

Not at all, you're perfectly fine. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a pre-paid shipping label. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Wow. Thank you, you've really helped me out today. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Nope, that was it. Have a great day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
